A confident YOUNG BRAZILIAN businessman is photographed OUTDOORS in an elegant executive setting (modern city street, stone steps outside a classic office building, contemporary plaza, business cafe/terrace) from a THREE-QUARTER or SIDE-BACK camera angle, so the backpack is clearly seen WORN ON HIS BACK behind him with BOTH shoulder straps firmly on both shoulders, his face visible in an elegant side / three-quarter profile. He wears a sharp tailored dark business blazer or suit (optionally sunglasses) and looks sophisticated, powerful and elite. The backpack MUST be worn centered on his BACK - never on his front or chest, never slung over one shoulder, never carried by hand or under the arm, never hanging at his side.
